title: S3.7c ACIS sphere-surface point tolerance predicate

scope.profile: Decoded sphere surface fields; parser-fed SAB 21800 rooted projection also exercised
scope.public_api: drw_pointWithinToleranceOfAcisSphereSurface returns signed radial distance to the decoded sphere locus and accepts only within a caller-supplied tolerance.
scope.radius_policy: The geometric locus uses the magnitude of the stored signed radius; source data is unchanged and no positivity convention is inferred.
scope.distance_policy: Signed distance is radial distance minus radius magnitude; negative is inside. The sphere center has a well-defined distance even though its closest-point direction is ambiguous.
scope.tolerance_policy: Tolerance must be finite and nonnegative; no ACIS/modeler default is inferred.
scope.refusal_policy: Wrong/missing surface, zero/non-finite radius, non-finite point/tolerance, unrepresentable signed distance, or out-of-tolerance point returns false without changing signedDistance.
non_claims: sphere parameterization or closest-point direction at center
B-rep validity or native consumer qualification
